trap.label: auxiliar e paralelismo
trap.wrong: Not only was late the report, but also incomplete.
trap.right: Not only was the report late, but it was also incomplete.
trap.why: Mantém-se a ordem do português. Em inglês, com be, inverta be + sujeito e mantenha paralelismo.

fix.wrong: Not only was late the report.
fix.right: Not only was the report late.
